details:
This update for alloy fixes the following issues:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-14362: HashiCorp memberlist before version 0.6.0 is vulnerable to a denial-of-service issue (bsc#1271206).
- CVE-2026-63209: github.com/klauspost/compress: signed integer overflow in s2.NewDict() allows an attacker to bypass
  repeat index validation and cause a process crash (bsc#1283592).
- CVE-2026-81871: go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlplog/otlploggrpc: OpenTelemetry-Go: TLS certificate bypass
  allows log telemetry interception and alteration (bsc#1281472).
- CVE-2026-81872: go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log: OpenTelemetry-Go: Denial of Service via attacker-driven log emission
  (bsc#1281473).
- CVE-2026-84303: google.golang.org/grpc: xDS RBAC HTTP filter implementation issue allows for bypass of authorization
  policies via mixed-case or canonical-case header matches (bsc#1279331).
- CVE-2026-84304: google.golang.org/grpc: heap memory exhaustion via HTTP/2 DATA frame fragmentation (bsc#1279232).
- CVE-2026-84445: google.golang.org/grpc: DoS via crash due to missing `:authority` and `Host` headers in gRPC-Go xDS
  servers (bsc#1279394).

Non security issue fixed:

- alloy 1.20.1: alloy.service references missing /usr/lib/alloy/alloy-wrapper (203/EXEC) (bsc#1285585).

Changes for alloy:

- Increase required memory in constraints
- Update to version 1.20.1:
 * Bug fixes:
 loki: Add the timestamp to batch size calculation
 loki: Include estimate for stream labels in batch size
 loki: Make byte counters count uncompressed bytes
 otelcol.connector.host_info: Fix potential over-count
 otelcol.receiver.cloudflare: Default max_request_body_size
 to 20MiB
 prometheus.remote_write: Tolerate unknown WAL record types
- Update to version 1.20.0:
 * BREAKING CHANGE: discovery.hetzner: no longer exports the
 __meta_hetzner_datacenter label for targets with role =
 'hcloud'
 * BREAKING CHANGE: otelcol.receiver.filelog: top_n now
 distinguishes an explicit 0 from leaving it unset
 * Features:
 loki.source.podlogs: Add use_apiserver_cache to reduce API
 server load
 loki.write: Add max_streams to limit active streams
 pyroscope.scrape: Support scraping custom pprof profiles
 * Enhancements:
 discovery.kubernetes: Add support for EndpointSlice
 filtering by service
 loki.process: stage.geoip now supports GeoLite2 City database
 discovery.file: Fix targets not updating on content change
 prometheus.relabel: Fix metrics getting stuck in NaN state
